problem: A smooth pressure pulse drains through two zero-pressure ends while the side faces remain sealed.
result: Maximum pressure error: 0.0424% of the initial amplitude; storage error 0.0509%. Stored fluid plus outflow equals the initial volume within 1.19e-21 m³ (independent integration).
scope: 3D 10 by 1 by 1 m column, 0.25 m spacing, 0.05 s steps through 10 s. All 200 steps on each of three meshes enter the pressure, storage and boundary-budget checks.
meaning: This checks open-boundary drainage and the discrete global fluid ledger at constant capacity. Unsaturated coupling, changing storage and remapping still require separate budgets.
